verdict.rationale: The only programmatic counterparty-clearance capability in the evidence is the Compliance API's address screening, which creates a screening request for a specific blockchain address and chain (circle-docs-26). In CPN's managed mode, Circle says it handles compliance on the integrator's behalf (circle-docs-30). Neither amounts to documented KYC/KYB onboarding endpoints for customers or recipients, and Mint access is described only as an application for qualified businesses (circle-docs-13). missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB endpoints or flows for customers and recipients, identity/business verification status gating before sends and receives, onboarding webhooks or states, independent or hands-on corroboration.
